name: Classic Margherita Pizza
directions: Preheat oven to 250°C (482°F) with a baking stone if available.
Roll out dough to a 12-inch circle on a floured surface.
Spread tomato sauce evenly over dough, leaving a 1/2-inch border.
Scatter mozzarella cheese over sauce.
Bake on the stone for 10-12 minutes until crust is crisp and cheese melts.
Finish with basil leaves, drizzle with olive oil, and season with salt and optional parmesan.
Slice and serve immediately.
image_description: The image depicts a classic Margherita pizza, characterized by its thin crust, cooked to a golden brown with visible char marks. The pizza is topped with a layer of red tomato sauce, melted white cheese, and fresh green basil leaves arranged in a symmetrical pattern across the surface. The pizza is presented on a round wooden board, cut into four equal slices, with one slice partially pulled away from the rest.

name: Chicken Tikka Masala
ingredients: 1 cup heavy cream or coconut cream
directions: Marinate chicken in yogurt, lemon juice, garam masala, cumin, coriander, and a pinch of salt for at least 30 minutes.
In a large pan, heat oil and sauté onion until translucent.
Add garlic and ginger; cook 1 minute until fragrant.
Add marinated chicken; cook until browned on all sides.
Stir in crushed tomatoes and simmer 15 minutes.
Reduce heat and add cream; simmer 5-10 minutes until sauce thickens.
Garnish with cilantro and serve with rice or naan.
image_description: The image depicts a serving of 'Chicken Tikka Masala', a dish consisting of grilled chicken pieces in a rich, orange-red sauce, garnished with fresh green herbs. The chicken is presented in a copper-colored, metal bowl with two handles, accompanied by a side of white rice and naan bread on a dark wooden table. The portion appears to be generous, suggesting a main course serving.

name: Vegetable Stir-Fry with Tofu
directions: Toss tofu with soy sauce and cornstarch.
Heat oil in a wok or large skillet over high heat.
Fry tofu until golden; remove and set aside.
Add garlic and vegetables; stir-fry 3-4 minutes until crisp-tender.
Return tofu to pan; add rice vinegar, hoisin sauce, and sesame oil.
Cook 1-2 minutes until coated; serve with steamed rice.
image_description: The image depicts a Vegetable Stir-Fry with Tofu, presented in a white bowl. The dish features a medley of sautéed vegetables, including broccoli, carrots, and snap peas, accompanied by cubed tofu, all coated in a savory brown sauce. The portion is generously sized, served alongside a side of white rice in a smaller bowl and paired with chopsticks on the right side.

name: Greek Giouvertsa Salad with Lemon-Oregano Dressing
directions: Toss romaine, cucumber, tomatoes, onion, olives, and feta in a bowl.
Whisk olive oil, lemon juice, oregano, salt, and pepper to make dressing.
Pour dressing over the salad and toss to combine.
Serve immediately.
image_description: The image depicts a Greek salad, presented in a white bowl and featuring a medley of ingredients including lettuce, tomatoes, cucumbers, red onions, Kalamata olives, and crumbled feta cheese. The salad is accompanied by a silver serving spoon and is situated on a wooden table, surrounded by a small glass bowl of dressing, a lemon wedge, and a blue-and-white striped cloth napkin. The portion size appears to be generous, suggesting that the salad is intended to serve multiple people.

name: Spaghetti Aglio e Olio
directions: Cook spaghetti in salted water until al dente; reserve 1/2 cup pasta water.
Heat olive oil in a pan; add garlic and red pepper flakes, cook until fragrant and lightly golden.
Toss pasta with garlic oil, adding reserve water as needed.
Season, mix in parsley, and serve with parmesan.
image_description: The image depicts a dish of 'Spaghetti Aglio e Olio', showcasing a generous serving of spaghetti tossed with garlic, red pepper flakes, and parsley, topped with grated Parmesan cheese. The pasta is presented in a white bowl, garnished with additional parsley and accompanied by a fork on the side. The portion size appears to be a standard individual serving.

name: Distance-Glazed Salmon with Dill
directions: Preheat oven to 200°C (400°F).
Mix honey, soy sauce, mustard, and dill.
Season salmon with salt and pepper; brush with glaze.
Bake 10-12 minutes until flaky; drizzle remaining glaze over and serve.
image_description: The image depicts a glazed salmon fillet, cut into four portions and presented on a wooden cutting board. The salmon is adorned with fresh dill sprigs and a glossy glaze, accompanied by a fork resting on one of the portions. The dish is garnished with lemon wedges and surrounded by scattered herbs and spices, adding to its visually appealing presentation.

name: Tomato Basil Soup
directions: Sauté onion and garlic in olive oil until translucent.
Add crushed tomatoes and broth; simmer 15 minutes.
Blend until smooth or leave chunky based on preference.
Stir in cream and basil; season to taste and serve.
image_description: The image presents a vibrant and appetizing bowl of tomato basil soup, garnished with fresh basil leaves and surrounded by an assortment of ingredients. The soup is contained within a light blue ceramic bowl featuring a brown rim, which is positioned centrally in the frame. The surrounding ingredients include olive oil, garlic cloves, red chili peppers, salt, and additional fresh basil leaves, all arranged artfully on a light grey surface.

name: Pad Thai
ingredients: 1 tablespoon palm sugar or brown sugar
directions: Prepare noodles according to package; drain and set aside.
Mix tamarind paste, fish sauce, and sugar to make sauce.
Sauté garlic in oil; add shrimp or chicken and cook through.
Push meat aside, scramble eggs in the pan, then mix with noodles.
Add sauce and bean sprouts; toss quickly.
Garnish with peanuts, lime wedges, and chili flakes if desired.
image_description: The image depicts a plate of Pad Thai, a stir-fry dish featuring rice noodles cooked with succulent shrimp, scrambled eggs, green onions, and cashews. The dish is presented on a large, shallow ceramic plate, garnished with fresh green onions and a lime wedge, and accompanied by various ingredients and seasonings arranged around it on a wooden table. The portion size appears generous, suggesting a satisfying meal for one person.

name: Chickpea Falafel with Tahini
ingredients: Tahini sauce: 1/4 cup tahini, lemon juice, water
directions: Pulse chickpeas, onion, garlic, parsley, flour, and spices until coarse.
Form into small patties or balls.
Fry in hot oil until golden and crisp.
Whisk tahini with lemon juice and water to desired consistency.
Serve falafel with tahini sauce.
image_description: The image presents a dish of 'Chickpea Falafel', characterized by six golden-brown, crispy fried patties arranged on a plate with sliced red onions, lemon wedges, and fresh parsley. The falafel is accompanied by various ingredients and condiments, including chickpeas, tahini sauce, spices, and herbs, which are displayed in surrounding bowls and garnishes. The presentation features a visually appealing combination of earthy tones, with the falafel and chickpeas showcasing a warm beige color, while the parsley adds a vibrant green accent.

name: Beef Tacos with Salsa Verde
directions: Cook beef with taco seasoning until browned.
Warm tortillas in a dry skillet.
Fill tortillas with beef, lettuce, tomatoes, and cheese.
Top with salsa verde and sour cream if desired.
image_description: The image shows a plate of four beef tacos, each consisting of a soft tortilla shell filled with seasoned ground beef, shredded lettuce, diced tomatoes, shredded cheese, guacamole, and sour cream. The tacos are arranged on a gray plate, accompanied by additional toppings and condiments in the background, including salsa, sour cream, and shredded cheese. The portion size is moderate, with four tacos presented as a single serving.

name: Pan-Seared Ribeye Steak
directions: Season steaks with salt and pepper.
Sear in a hot pan with butter until desired doneness (about 4-5 minutes per side for medium-rare).
Add garlic and thyme during the last minute, spooning butter over steaks.
Rest 5 minutes before serving.
image_description: The image depicts a pan-seared ribeye steak, cooked to medium-rare and presented in a cast-iron skillet. The steak is accompanied by sprigs of thyme, garlic cloves, and cubes of butter, all of which are visible within the skillet or surrounding it on the dark surface. The portion size appears to be a single serving, with the steak being a substantial tomahawk cut.

name: Lentil Dal with Cumin and Turmeric
directions: Rinse lentils until water runs clear.
Sauté onion and garlic in oil until soft.
Add cumin and turmeric, cook 1 minute.
Add lentils and water; simmer 20-25 minutes until soft.
Season and garnish with cilantro.
image_description: The image depicts a bowl of lentil dal, garnished with fresh cilantro, sliced onions, halved cherry tomatoes, and a slice of lime. The dish is presented in a ceramic bowl, accompanied by a spoon on the right side and surrounded by various ingredients, including a small bowl of turmeric powder, an onion, garlic cloves, and additional cilantro leaves. The vibrant colors of the dish are showcased against a dark background, with the dal's reddish-brown hue complemented by the green cilantro and the orange turmeric powder.

name: Miso-Glazed Cod with Sesame Rice
ingredients: Sesame seeds and green onions for garnish
directions: Whisk miso, mirin, soy sauce, and sugar to make glaze.
Brush cod with glaze and let sit 5 minutes.
Pan-sear or bake cod until flaky.
Fluff rice with sesame oil, top with cod, sesame seeds, and green onions.
image_description: The dish is a serving of miso-glazed cod on a bed of sesame rice, garnished with sliced green onions and sesame seeds. The cod is cooked to a golden brown and presented on top of a generous portion of white rice, which is drizzled with a savory sauce. The meal is served in a large, shallow bowl with a blue-green glaze and is accompanied by a side of plain white rice, soy sauce, and sesame seeds.

name: Caribbean Jerk Chicken
directions: Marinate chicken with jerk seasoning, lime juice, olive oil, and salt for 20 minutes.
Grill or bake until cooked through, about 20-25 minutes.
Rest briefly and serve with sides like rice and beans.
image_description: This image showcases a Caribbean Jerk Chicken dish, featuring four roasted chicken pieces arranged on a wooden platter and garnished with lime wedges and fresh mint leaves. The chicken is seasoned with a blend of spices, including peppercorns and rosemary, and appears to be glazed with a rich sauce. The platter is surrounded by various accompaniments, such as rice, beans, salt, and additional lime halves, adding to the overall presentation.

name: Roasted Tomato and Basil Pasta
directions: Roast tomatoes and garlic with olive oil for 15-20 minutes.
Cook pasta until al dente, reserve 1/2 cup pasta water.
Toss pasta with roasted tomatoes, add water to loosen if needed.
Stir in torn basil and parmesan; season to taste.
image_description: The image depicts a plate of penne pasta, roasted cherry tomatoes, and fresh basil leaves. The penne is cooked al dente and mixed with halved cherry tomatoes that have been roasted to bring out their natural sweetness, as well as fresh basil leaves. The dish is presented on a large, shallow ceramic plate with a brown rim and blue interior, garnished with additional basil leaves and sprinkled with grated Parmesan cheese.

name: Paneer Butter Masala
directions: Fry paneer lightly until golden; set aside.
Sauté onion with butter, add ginger-garlic paste.
Add tomato puree and simmer 10 minutes.
Stir in cream, garam masala, and paneer; simmer 5 minutes.
Season to taste and serve with rice or naan.
image_description: The image shows a bowl of 'Paneer Butter Masala', a popular Indian dish, featuring paneer (Indian cheese) cubes in a rich, reddish-orange sauce garnished with onions and herbs. The dish is presented in a large, shallow bowl and is accompanied by naan bread and basmati rice. The overall presentation is vibrant and appetizing, with a generous portion size.

name: Falooda (Dessert Drink)
ingredients: Cherries or shredded coconut for garnish
directions: In tall glasses, layer milk, rose syrup, soaked vermicelli, and sabja.
Add ice and garnish with cherries or coconut.
Serve with a spoon and straw.
image_description: This image showcases a visually appealing dessert drink, likely Falooda, presented in two tall glasses. The glasses are filled with layers of red jelly, vermicelli noodles, and white cream, topped with whipped cream, cherries, and mint leaves. The glasses are placed on a gray marble slab, surrounded by additional ingredients and garnishes, including bowls of pink powder, cherries, and rose petals.

name: Shakshuka
directions: Sauté onion and pepper in olive oil until soft.
Add garlic, tomatoes, paprika, and cumin; simmer 10 minutes.
Make four wells in sauce and crack in eggs.
Cover and cook until eggs set; garnish with parsley.
image_description: The image depicts a Shakshuka dish, characterized by a cast-iron skillet containing six eggs poached in a vibrant mixture of sautéed red and green bell peppers, onions, and tomatoes. The skillet is surrounded by various ingredients, including spices, herbs, garlic cloves, chili peppers, and small bowls of oil and tomato sauce, which are likely used to prepare the dish. The presentation is visually appealing, with a mix of bright colors from the vegetables and eggs against a dark background.

name: Cuban Black Beans and Rice
ingredients: 1 cup dried black beans (or 2 cans, drained)
directions: Soak beans if using dried (overnight recommended).
Sauté onion and garlic in oil; add beans, bay leaf, cumin, and water.
Simmer until beans are tender (about 45 minutes for dried).
Serve over rice.
image_description: The image depicts a traditional Cuban dish, 'Black Beans and Rice', presented on a white plate. The dish consists of a mound of white rice surrounded by black beans, garnished with sliced garlic cloves and two green leaves, likely bay leaves. The portion size appears to be generous, with a substantial amount of beans and rice visible.

name: Beef Bulgogi
ingredients: 500g sirloin or flank steak, thinly sliced
directions: Marinate beef with soy sauce, sugar, sesame oil, garlic, and ginger for 15-20 minutes.
Stir-fry in a hot pan 2-3 minutes until cooked.
Garnish with green onion and sesame seeds; serve with rice.
image_description: The image depicts a dish of sliced beef, likely Beef Bulgogi, presented on a large gray plate. The beef is cooked to medium-rare and arranged on top of onions, garnished with green onions and sesame seeds. The portion size appears generous, accompanied by various ingredients and seasonings surrounding the plate, including rice, garlic cloves, green onions, sesame seeds, and spices in small bowls.

name: Spanish Paella Valenciana
directions: Brown chicken and chorizo in olive oil; set aside.
Sauté onion and pepper; add tomatoes and cook until soft.
Add rice, saffron, and broth; bring to boil.
Return meat, cover, simmer until rice is cooked and liquid absorbed.
Rest 5 minutes before serving.
image_description: The image depicts a traditional Spanish Paella Valenciana, characterized by its vibrant yellow rice cooked in a large, shallow pan with two handles. The dish is garnished with chicken pieces, halved cherry tomatoes, onions, and red chili peppers, arranged in a visually appealing pattern. The presentation is enhanced by the surrounding ingredients, including whole onions, garlic cloves, tomatoes on the vine, salt, oil, and spices, which are scattered around the pan on a dark wooden surface.

name: Tom Yum Goong
directions: Boil stock with lemongrass, lime leaves, and galangal for 10 minutes.
Add mushrooms and shrimp; cook until shrimp turn pink.
Season with fish sauce and lime juice; add chili paste if desired.
image_description: This image depicts a bowl of 'Tom Yum Goong', a Thai soup featuring succulent shrimp, straw mushrooms, and fragrant herbs such as cilantro and lime leaves. The dish is presented in a white ceramic bowl, garnished with sliced red chilies and a wedge of lime, and accompanied by a white ceramic spoon. The vibrant orange broth is visible through the ingredients, and the portion size appears to be a single serving.

name: Chicken Caesar Salad
directions: Grill or pan-sear chicken; slice.
Toss lettuce with dressing and croutons.
Top with chicken slices and parmesan.
image_description: The image depicts a Chicken Caesar Salad, featuring grilled chicken breast sliced into thin strips and arranged on top of a bed of romaine lettuce. The salad is garnished with croutons, halved cherry tomatoes, and shaved parmesan cheese, all bound together by a creamy Caesar dressing. The dish is presented in a shallow bowl, showcasing a generous portion size.

name: Moussaka
ingredients: Bechamel sauce: butter, flour, milk, nutmeg
directions: Roast eggplant slices until tender.
Cook lamb with onion and garlic; add tomatoes and season.
Layer eggplant and meat mixture in dish; top with bechamel.
Bake until golden and set.
image_description: This image depicts a Moussaka, a Greek dish consisting of layered eggplant slices, ground meat, and cheese. The visible ingredients include sliced eggplant, a meat-based filling, melted cheese, and fresh herbs. The dish is presented in a rectangular baking pan, showcasing its layered composition and golden-brown color.

name: Shoyu Ramen (Quick)
directions: Simmer broth with soy sauce and miso.
Cook noodles separately.
Assemble bowls with broth, noodles, meat, egg, and green onions.
image_description: The image depicts a bowl of Shoyu Ramen, featuring thin, yellow noodles submerged in a light-brown broth. The dish is garnished with sliced chicken breast on the right side, green onions and enoki mushrooms at the top right, and two halves of a soft-boiled egg at the top left. The bowl is black with a glossy finish and is set against a dark gray background.

name: Lemon Garlic Shrimp Pasta
directions: Cook pasta until al dente.
Sauté garlic in olive oil; add shrimp until pink.
Toss with pasta, lemon zest/juice, and parsley.
Season and serve.
image_description: The image depicts a plate of 'Lemon Garlic Shrimp Pasta', featuring cooked shrimp, fettuccine noodles, and green beans tossed in a light sauce, garnished with lemon slices and herbs. The dish is presented on a large, shallow ceramic plate with a speckled brown glaze, surrounded by various ingredients such as lemons, garlic cloves, salt, and pepper. The portion size appears generous, with a substantial amount of pasta and shrimp visible on the plate.

name: Ratatouille
directions: Sauté onion and garlic in olive oil.
Add vegetables; cook slowly with herbs until tender.
Season and serve warm or room temp.
image_description: This image depicts a vibrant and colorful Ratatouille dish, showcasing a medley of sliced vegetables including zucchini, eggplant, tomatoes, onions, and bell peppers. The ingredients are presented in a white bowl, garnished with fresh herbs, and accompanied by whole vegetables and seasonings on a wooden cutting board. The overall presentation is visually appealing, with a focus on showcasing the freshness and variety of the ingredients.

name: Crispy Skin Salmon with Dill Yogurt
directions: Season salmon; sear skin-side down in butter until crisp.
Flip and cook to desired doneness.
Mix yogurt with dill and a squeeze of lemon; serve with salmon.
image_description: This image depicts a plate of 'Crispy Skin Salmon with Dill Yogurt', showcasing two grilled salmon fillets with crispy skin, seasoned with black pepper and garnished with fresh dill. The dish is accompanied by a side of white yogurt sauce infused with dill and a sprinkle of spices, served alongside lemon wedges on a gray ceramic plate. The presentation features a harmonious balance of colors, with the pink salmon, yellow lemon, and green dill creating a visually appealing arrangement.

name: Thai Green Curry with Vegetables
ingredients: Assorted vegetables (bell peppers, zucchini, snow peas)
directions: Sauté curry paste briefly in oil.
Add coconut milk and simmer 5 minutes.
Add protein and vegetables; cook until tender.
Season with fish sauce and garnish with herbs; serve over rice.
image_description: The image depicts a vibrant and colorful dish of Thai Green Curry with Vegetables, served in a large bowl alongside a portion of white rice. The curry is generously filled with an assortment of vegetables, including sliced zucchini, diced bell peppers, tofu cubes, and snow peas, all of which are visible within the bowl. The presentation is visually appealing, with the ingredients arranged artfully and garnished with fresh basil leaves, set against a backdrop of various ingredients and utensils scattered around the bowl.

name: Mango Sticky Rice
directions: Cook rice in water until tender.
Warm coconut milk with sugar and salt.
Pour coconut sauce over cooked rice and let absorb.
Serve with mango slices.
image_description: The image depicts a vibrant and appetizing dish of 'Mango Sticky Rice', showcasing a harmonious blend of ingredients and presentation. The main components include a bowl of white glutinous rice cooked in coconut milk, topped with diced mango and garnished with green leaves, accompanied by additional mango pieces on the side. The dish is presented on a blue plate, with a spoon containing salt and other ingredients visible nearby, suggesting a traditional Southeast Asian culinary style.

name: Herbed Quinoa Salad
ingredients: Lemon vinaigrette: lemon juice, olive oil, salt, pepper
directions: Cook quinoa in water until fluffy; cool.
Toss with vegetables, herbs, and vinaigrette.
Chill 10 minutes before serving if desired.
image_description: This image depicts a 'Herbed Quinoa Salad' presented in a white ceramic bowl with a brown rim. The salad comprises cooked quinoa mixed with sliced cucumbers, halved cherry tomatoes, and parsley leaves, arranged in a visually appealing manner. The dish is served on a dark grey surface, accompanied by various ingredients and garnishes, including lemon wedges, whole cherry tomatoes, olive oil in a small bowl, and a fork to the right of the bowl.

name: Beef Shawarma Wrap
directions: Marinate beef with shawarma spices.
Cook beef in a hot pan until done.
Fill pitas with beef and vegetables; drizzle with sauce.
image_description: The image depicts a Beef Shawarma Wrap, showcasing a generous portion of thinly sliced beef, crisp lettuce, juicy tomatoes, crunchy cucumbers, and onions, all wrapped in a warm pita bread. The dish is accompanied by an assortment of condiments and toppings, including hummus, tzatziki sauce, and spices, arranged around the wrap on a dark surface. The vibrant colors of the ingredients add to the visual appeal of the dish, with the red tomatoes and green cucumbers creating a pop of color against the earthy tones of the pita bread and beef.

name: Pesto Chicken Bake
directions: Season chicken and place in baking dish.
Top each with pesto, mozzarella, and tomatoes.
Bake at 200°C (400°F) for 22-25 minutes until chicken is cooked.
image_description: This image depicts a 'Pesto Chicken Bake', a dish consisting of four seared chicken breasts on a bed of pasta, cheese, and pesto sauce, topped with roasted cherry tomatoes. The ingredients are arranged in a white baking dish, accompanied by a wooden spoon containing additional pesto sauce and a knife and fork on a beige napkin to the side. The presentation features a vibrant color palette, with the green pesto sauce, red cherry tomatoes, and golden-brown chicken breasts creating a visually appealing combination.

name: Baked Eggplant Parmesan
directions: Dip eggplant slices in egg then breadcrumbs; bake until tender.
Layer with marinara and cheese; bake until golden.
image_description: The image depicts a rectangular baking dish containing Baked Eggplant Parmesan, showcasing layers of breaded and baked eggplant slices, tomato sauce, and melted cheese. The dish is presented on a wooden cutting board, surrounded by various ingredients such as tomatoes, onions, garlic, parsley, and bowls of tomato sauce and grated cheese. The overall presentation is visually appealing, with a generous portion size that suggests a satisfying meal for multiple people.

name: Moroccan Chickpea Stew
directions: Sauté onion and garlic; add spices.
Add chickpeas and tomatoes; simmer 15-20 minutes.
Garnish with cilantro and serve.
image_description: The image depicts a bowl of Moroccan Chickpea Stew, showcasing a hearty and flavorful dish. The stew is composed of chickpeas cooked in a rich red broth, garnished with fresh cilantro and diced tomatoes, all presented in a decorative ceramic bowl. The portion size appears to be generous, filling the bowl to the brim, and is accompanied by various ingredients and condiments on a wooden table.

name: Crunchy Cabbage Slaw
directions: Mix dressing ingredients.
Toss with shredded cabbage and carrot.
Chill slightly before serving.
image_description: The image presents a 'Crunchy Cabbage Slaw' dish, comprising shredded green cabbage and carrots, arranged in a large blue bowl. The slaw is accompanied by various ingredients, including mayonnaise, vinegar, sugar, and seasonings, which are displayed in smaller bowls around the main dish. The presentation is simple yet visually appealing, with a focus on showcasing the fresh ingredients and their quantities.

name: Ceviche de Pescado
directions: Cure fish in lime juice for about 10-15 minutes until opaque.
Mix with onion, chili, and cilantro; season and serve.
image_description: This image depicts a bowl of 'Ceviche de Pescado', a dish consisting of raw fish marinated in citrus juices. The bowl contains diced white fish, thinly sliced red onions, halved red chili peppers, and cilantro leaves, garnished with a lime wedge. The ingredients are arranged in a visually appealing manner within a ceramic bowl, which is placed on a wooden cutting board surrounded by additional ingredients such as whole red chili peppers, salt crystals, and lime halves.

name: Thai Basil Chicken (Pad Krapow Gai)
directions: Sauté garlic and chili in oil until fragrant.
Add chicken and cook through.
Stir in soy and fish sauces; toss with basil until wilted.
Serve over steamed rice.
image_description: The image depicts a dish of Thai Basil Chicken, also known as Pad Krapow Gai, presented on a white plate with a blue patterned rim. The dish consists of stir-fried chicken breast or thigh, cooked with Thai basil leaves, red chili peppers, and other seasonings, served alongside a generous portion of white rice. The ingredients are arranged artfully on the plate, with a small bowl of sauce and various garnishes surrounding it.

name: Caprese Salad
directions: Alternate tomato and mozzarella slices on a plate.
Top with basil; drizzle olive oil and balsamic glaze.
Season with salt and pepper.
image_description: The image depicts a Caprese salad, a traditional Italian dish, presented on a white plate. The salad consists of sliced tomatoes and mozzarella cheese, garnished with fresh basil leaves and drizzled with olive oil and balsamic glaze. The ingredients are arranged in a visually appealing pattern, showcasing the vibrant colors of the tomatoes, the creamy white of the mozzarella, and the deep green of the basil.

name: Pumpkin Risotto
directions: Sauté onion in olive oil until translucent.
Add rice and toast 1-2 minutes.
Add warm broth gradually, stirring until absorbed.
Stir in pumpkin puree, butter, and parmesan; season to taste.
image_description: The image depicts a pumpkin risotto dish in a large, dark gray pan. The risotto is divided into four sections: a creamy white base, a layer of orange pumpkin puree topped with diced pumpkin, a section of thinly sliced red onions, and a corner with melted butter. The pan is surrounded by various ingredients, including a whole and halved pumpkin, shallots, garlic cloves, salt, butter, and a bowl of broth, all arranged on a dark gray surface.

name: Garlic Butter Shrimp
directions: Melt butter; add garlic and cook 1 minute.
Add shrimp; cook until pink.
Squeeze lemon juice; garnish with parsley and serve.
image_description: The image depicts a dish of Garlic Butter Shrimp, showcasing succulent pink shrimp cooked in a rich, golden butter sauce infused with garlic and parsley. The shrimp are presented in a black skillet on a wooden tray, surrounded by additional ingredients such as lemon wedges, whole garlic bulbs, and small bowls of melted butter. The portion size appears to be generous, with approximately 20-25 shrimp visible in the skillet.

name: Roasted Red Pepper Hummus
directions: Blend all ingredients until smooth.
Drizzle with olive oil and serve with pita or veggies.
image_description: The image shows a dish of 'Roasted Red Pepper Hummus', which is a creamy beige dip garnished with olive oil, coarse salt, black pepper, red pepper flakes, and a red chili pepper. The hummus is served in a black bowl and topped with chickpeas and sliced red bell peppers, surrounded by various ingredients such as pita bread, garlic cloves, salt, and additional red peppers. The presentation is visually appealing, with a generous portion size that suggests it is ready to be served.

name: Garlic Naan
directions: Mix ingredients to form dough; knead until smooth.
Let rise 1 hour; divide and roll into rounds.
Cook on hot skillet 2-3 minutes per side.
Brush with garlic butter and serve.
image_description: The image depicts a plate of garlic naan, a type of Indian flatbread. The naan is arranged in a circular pattern on a gray plate, with five pieces visible and topped with garlic cloves and herbs. A small bowl of garlic cloves is placed in the center of the naan, accompanied by a fork to the left and a knife to the right.

name: Butter Chicken
directions: Sauté onion and garlic in butter.
Add chicken and cook until sealed.
Stir in tomato sauce and garam masala; simmer 15 minutes.
Stir in cream; season and serve with rice or naan.
image_description: The image depicts a dish of 'Butter Chicken', a popular Indian cuisine, presented in a blue bowl. The dish features tender chicken cubes and onions in a rich, red sauce, garnished with fresh green leaves and various spices, showcasing a vibrant color palette. The portion size appears generous, filling the bowl, and the presentation is visually appealing, with the ingredients artfully arranged.

name: Coconut Curry Lentil Soup
directions: Sauté onion and garlic; add curry powder.
Add lentils, coconut milk, and broth; simmer 25 minutes.
Season and serve hot.
image_description: This image depicts a bowl of 'Coconut Curry Lentil Soup', characterized by its vibrant orange-yellow hue and creamy texture. The dish is garnished with a swirl of white cream, red chili peppers, onions, and herbs, adding visual appeal to the presentation. The bowl is surrounded by various ingredients, including whole lentils, turmeric powder, and lemon halves, suggesting a homemade or artisanal preparation style.

name: Gyro Wrap
ingredients: Gyro meat (lamb or chicken) or substitute with sliced chicken
directions: Cook gyro meat until browned.
Warm pita; fill with meat and vegetables.
Top with tzatziki.
image_description: The image depicts a Gyro Wrap, a traditional Greek dish, consisting of a warm pita bread wrapped around thinly sliced grilled meat, likely lamb or beef, accompanied by fresh vegetables such as tomatoes, cucumbers, and red onions, and topped with a dollop of tzatziki sauce. The wrap is presented on a wooden cutting board, garnished with herbs and served with additional tzatziki sauce on the side. The portion size appears to be a single serving, suitable for one person.

name: Pollo a la Brasa (Peruvian Roast Chicken)
directions: Marinate chicken with garlic, cumin, paprika, salt, and pepper.
Roast at 200°C (400°F) for 40-45 minutes until cooked.
Serve with lime wedges.
image_description: The image depicts a whole roasted chicken, known as 'Pollo a la Brasa,' presented on a large clay platter and surrounded by lime wedges and spices. The chicken is roasted to a golden brown color with visible seasoning and herbs on its surface. The dish is served family-style, with the chicken cut into eight pieces and arranged in a circular pattern on the platter.

name: Mango Salsa Chicken
directions: Season chicken and sear in a pan.

name: Beef and Broccoli
ingredients: 300g flank steak, thinly sliced against the grain
directions: Toss beef slices with cornstarch and a splash of soy sauce; let sit for 10 minutes.
Blanch broccoli in boiling water for 2 minutes, then drain.
Heat oil in a wok and sear beef at high heat until browned; remove.
Stir-fry ginger for 30 seconds, then add broccoli, oyster sauce, and soy sauce.
Return beef to the wok and toss everything together for 1 minute.
Serve immediately.
image_description: The image depicts a vibrant and appetizing dish of beef and broccoli, presented in a large black wok on a wooden platter. The dish features tender chunks of beef, cooked to a medium-rare, and an abundance of steamed broccoli florets, accompanied by sliced mushrooms and scattered seasonings. The ingredients are arranged artfully within the wok, with various condiments and garnishes displayed around the platter, including oyster sauce, soy sauce, ginger, and cashews.

name: General Tso's Chicken
ingredients: 500g chicken thighs, cut into bite-sized pieces
directions: Coat chicken pieces thoroughly in cornstarch.
Deep fry chicken in hot oil until crispy and golden; drain on paper towels.
In a separate pan, sauté ginger, garlic, and chilies.
Add soy sauce, vinegar, and sugar; simmer until the sugar dissolves.
Toss the crispy chicken into the sauce until fully coated.
Serve over white rice.
image_description: The image depicts a plate of General Tso's Chicken, a Chinese-American dish consisting of deep-fried chicken pieces coated in a sweet and spicy sauce, served with steamed white rice. The chicken is garnished with sliced red chili peppers and pieces of ginger, and is presented in a generous portion on a brown ceramic plate. The overall presentation is colorful and appetizing, with the vibrant red peppers adding a pop of color to the dish.

name: Pork Potstickers (Dumplings)
directions: Mix pork, cabbage, soy sauce, sesame oil, and ginger in a bowl.
Place a teaspoon of filling in the center of a wrapper, moisten edges, and fold/pleat to seal.
Heat oil in a flat skillet and arrange dumplings in a single layer.
Fry for 2 minutes until bottoms are golden.
Pour in water and immediately cover with a lid to steam for 5-7 minutes.
Remove lid and cook until water evaporates and bottoms are crispy again.
image_description: The image depicts a dish of pan-fried dumplings, known as potstickers, arranged in a single layer within a cast-iron skillet. The dumplings are accompanied by a small bowl containing a dark sauce and garnished with sesame seeds, and are served on a wooden board or trivet. The presentation is visually appealing, with the golden-brown dumplings and savory sauce creating a mouth-watering display.

name: Hot and Sour Soup
directions: Bring broth to a boil in a large pot.
Add tofu, bamboo shoots, soy sauce, and white pepper.
Stir in the cornstarch slurry and simmer until thickened.
Slowly drizzle in the beaten egg while stirring gently to create ribbons.
Stir in the rice vinegar at the very end to preserve the 'sour' punch.
Garnish with green onions.
image_description: The image depicts a large pot of Hot and Sour Soup, featuring a medley of ingredients including tofu, bamboo shoots, and noodles. The dish is presented in a black pot with two handles, accompanied by various condiments and garnishes such as green onions, chili sauce, and a raw egg yolk. The portion size appears to be substantial, suggesting it is intended for multiple servings.

name: Chow Mein
directions: Boil noodles according to package instructions, drain, and set aside.
Heat oil in a wok and stir-fry cabbage and carrots for 3 minutes.
Add the noodles to the wok.
Mix soy sauce, oyster sauce, and sugar, then pour over the noodles.
Toss at high heat for 2-3 minutes until noodles are slightly charred and well coated.
Serve hot.
image_description: This image depicts a serving of 'Chow Mein', a Chinese dish consisting of stir-fried noodles, mixed vegetables, and seasonings. The visible ingredients include yellow noodles, broccoli, carrots, green onions, peas, and cabbage, all stir-fried together. The dish is presented on a large, shallow ceramic plate with a brown rim, accompanied by chopsticks and two small bowls containing soy sauce and sesame seeds or another condiment.

name: Wonton Soup
directions: Bring chicken broth and soy sauce to a boil in a pot.
Add the wontons and simmer for 5 minutes (or until they float).
Add bok choy and cook for 1 minute until wilted.
Turn off heat and stir in sesame oil.
Ladle into bowls and garnish with green onions.
image_description: The image depicts a traditional Chinese dish, 'Wonton Soup', presented in three bowls on a wooden tray. The soup contains wontons and bok choy in a clear broth, accompanied by various seasonings and ingredients, including sliced green onions, soy sauce, and spices, arranged around the bowls. The portion size is moderate, with each bowl containing four to five wontons and a generous amount of bok choy.

name: Honey Walnut Shrimp
directions: Dip shrimp in egg, then coat with cornstarch.
Fry shrimp in hot oil until golden and crispy; drain.
In a large bowl, whisk together mayonnaise, honey, and condensed milk.
Toss the warm shrimp and candied walnuts into the sauce until evenly coated.
Serve immediately, usually garnished with steamed broccoli.
image_description: The image depicts a dish of 'Honey Walnut Shrimp', showcasing succulent shrimp coated in a rich, creamy sauce and served atop a bed of walnuts, broccoli florets, and quail eggs. The shrimp are arranged artfully in a blue ceramic bowl with a brown rim, creating a visually appealing composition. The overall presentation is generous, with a substantial portion size that fills the bowl.
